figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(discount_cents) discount,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER(ORDER BY net DESC,product_id) bucket FROM a) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0),2) margin_pct,discount discount_cents,refund refund_cents FROM b WHERE bucket=1 AND 100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0)<30 ORDER BY net DESC

parts.note: 只保留满足这个条件的行：bucket=1 AND 100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0)<30。

figures.title: 毛利率
figures.meaning: 衡量净销售中毛利所占的比例；本课用它筛出毛利率偏低的商品。
figures.interpretation: 毛利率 {result}：净销售中有这个比例是毛利；本课的筛选条件是毛利率严格低于 30%。

notes.label: 分组
notes.text: 净销售额位于第一四分组

notes.label: 易错口径
notes.text: 先筛毛利率低于30%的商品，再对剩余商品分四档
分母为 0 时，结果为空（NULL），不会报错，也不会写成 0。

figures.title: 两道筛选如何叠加？

panels.label: 第一步：净销售最高的四分之一
panels.note: 按净销售从高到低分成四组，只取第一组；下表是该组里净销售最高的 4 件商品。

check.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(discount_cents) discount,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER(ORDER BY net DESC,product_id) bucket FROM a)  SELECT COUNT(*) FROM b WHERE bucket=1

panels.label: 第二步：只留毛利率低于 30%
panels.note: 在第一组里再筛毛利率；下表是剩下的商品中净销售最高的 3 件。

check.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (WITH a AS (SELECT product_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost,SUM(discount_cents) discount,SUM(refund_cents) refund FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY product_id), b AS (SELECT *,NTILE(4) OVER(ORDER BY net DESC,product_id) bucket FROM a) SELECT product_id,net net_cents,ROUND(100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0),2) margin_pct,discount discount_cents,refund refund_cents FROM b WHERE bucket=1 AND 100.0*(net-cost)/NULLIF(net,0)<30 ORDER BY net DESC)

figures.conclusion: 高销售不等于高毛利：第一四分组的 120 件商品中，只有 23 件毛利率低于 30%。
